quests.title: Plant the next cell too
quests.ask: The starter plants one cell and steps on. Make that happen again, so the next cell gets a gem as well.
quests.nudge: Which lines would you copy to do it again? Those are the ones a loop could repeat.

quests.title: Write it once, repeat it
quests.ask: Write the lines that plant and step only once, and let a `for` loop repeat them.
quests.nudge: If you had to plant a hundred cells, what would you want to write?

quests.title: The whole row, no gaps
quests.ask: Plant one gem on every cell the Goal view shows, using up the bag exactly.
quests.nudge: How many cells does the picture show? What does that tell your loop?
